fields.description: JSON key that carries the Item Code in printed QR labels.
fields.label: QR Item Key

fields.description: JSON key that carries the Batch No in printed QR labels.
fields.label: QR Batch Key
Help
fields.options: The WMS app only accepts QR labels whose content is a JSON object using these keys, for example {"item_code": "ITEM-001", "batch_no": "B-2026-01"} (batch label) or {"item_code": "ITEM-001"} (item label). Print them with the WMS Batch QR Label / WMS Item QR Label print formats, or many per A4 page with Batch / Item list > Actions > Print QR Label Sheet (layout in the WMS Batch QR Label Sheet / WMS Item QR Label Sheet print formats).

fields.label: Receipt Workflow States
fields.description: Optional. Workflow states (one per line) of draft Purchase Receipts that the warehouse may receive in the app. Leave empty to list the draft states in which one of the user's roles may edit (or every draft when Purchase Receipt has no workflow).

fields.label: Receipt Field Values
fields.description: Optional. JSON of values written onto a Purchase Receipt when the app confirms it: keys "Purchase Receipt.<fieldname>" for the header and "Purchase Receipt Item.<fieldname>" for every row, e.g. {"Purchase Receipt Item.department": "Warehouse - E"}. They overwrite what the draft carries, for site rules that require the warehouse's own values on submit.

fields.label: Help
fields.options: The app's Orders > Receive lists draft Purchase Receipts at the warehouse stage. The warehouse counts the goods against the rows; confirming writes the counted quantities, drops rows that were not received (the Purchase Order stays open for them) and submits the receipt through the workflow action that submits it (or directly without a workflow).

fields.label: Batch No Field
fields.description: Optional. Fieldname of the Batch field that holds the supplier's batch number as printed on the material (the app looks batches up by it, spaces and case ignored). Empty: custom_batch_no when the site has it, else the Batch ID is the batch number.

fields.label: Batch ID Pattern
fields.description: Optional. How the app names a Batch it creates while receiving: placeholders {batch_no}, {item} and {counter} (numeric prefix of the last batch + 1). Empty: {counter}-{item}-{batch_no} when a Batch No Field exists, else {batch_no}.

fields.label: QC No Field
fields.description: Optional. Fieldname of the Batch field that holds the quality-control number assigned to a delivery; the app asks for it when it creates a batch and shows it when several batches carry one supplier number. Empty: custom_qc_no when the site has it, else none.

fields.label: Help
fields.options: Batch tracked items whose batches ERPNext does not create itself (Has Batch No without Automatically Create New Batch) need a Batch before the receipt is submitted. The app reads the batch number off the material, finds the Batch or creates it (find_batch / create_batch, Stock User needs create on Batch), and counts each batch under its row; a row received in several batches is split into one Purchase Receipt Item per batch when the receipt is confirmed. The expiry date defaults to the manufacturing date plus the item's shelf life. Sites that give every delivery a quality-control number keep it in the QC No Field: the app asks for it when creating a batch, and the same supplier number under another QC number is another Batch.
